offers.name: Lenovo Legion 7i 16" Gaming Laptop -Glacier White (Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX/32GB RAM/1TB SSD/GeForce RTX 5060/Win 11)

reviews.quote: It's one of the lightest and fastest gaming laptops we've tested with the same RTX 5060 GPU due to its high 115 W TGP target. ... Core temperatures are relatively high, battery life is average at best, and loud fans are unavoidable if playing on Performance mode.

The new Legion 7 16IAX10 with Core Ultra 7 255HX CPU and GeForce RTX 5060 graphics is almost consistently faster than most other laptops with the same GPU in our database sometimes by up to 20 percent.

professional.note: NBC tested this exact configuration (255HX/RTX 5060/32GB/1TB/165Hz OLED). RTINGS has no Legion 7i Gen 10 review (404) — not cited.

praises: ~2 kg / 17.9 mm for a 16-inch OLED gaming laptop — genuinely portable; called a 'finely-tuned' and cheaper Razer Blade 16 alternative
RTX 5060 runs at full 115 W with the fast HX CPU, beating most other 5060 laptops by up to 20% in games (NBC game benchmarks)
Comfortable TrueStrike keyboard and large clickpad; matte Glacier White finish resists fingerprints
Fast charging (<90 min) plus 100 W USB-C PD over Thunderbolt 4 — can run off a small GaN charger away from gaming
Fast SD card reader (234 MB/s), 5MP webcam with hardware kill switch, and inky OLED with 0.6 ms response praised for creator/travel hybrid use
complaints: Battery only ~4h40m WiFi browsing — far below 16-inch rivals (7+h); high iGPU idle draw (9.4-10.6 W) drains it even doing nothing
Fans pulse audibly (~30 dB) during simple web browsing on Balanced mode; 54.6 dB in Performance mode gaming
Glossy OLED is mandatory — reflections in bright rooms; bright power-button glow cannot be disabled (NBC)
Speakers (2x2W) are quiet and thin for a 16-inch chassis

CPU hits 105°C briefly under heavy load (light cooling at its limits with Arrow Lake-HX); white paint shows scratches more readily than dark chassis, and Legion-line threads report warranty repair friction plus occasional fan-bearing noise

design_philosophy: The Legion 7i Gen 10 is Lenovo's slim-and-light gaming flagship: an Arrow Lake-HX CPU and up to 100% color-gamut OLED in a sub-2 kg aluminum chassis, trading top-tier GPU options (capped at RTX 5070) for portability. This config pairs the Ultra 7 255HX with a full-power 115 W RTX 5060 — the sweet spot NBC calls a lighter, cheaper Razer Blade 16 alternative. It maximizes performance-per-gram at the cost of battery life and fan noise, targeting gamers who travel.
rating_notes: NBC-tested config, ratings anchored directly (87%). Battery 4.0 per measured 4h40m WiFi (matches Legion Pro 7i calibration despite lighter chassis — HX+iGPU drain). Gaming 6.8: strong-for-class 115W RTX 5060 (up to 20% above 5060 average) but 8GB VRAM limits AAA at QHD (CP2077 QHD 59 fps, Alan Wake 2 QHD 37 fps). Portability 8.0 exceptional for 16" (1.98 kg/17.9 mm). Readability_bright docked for mandatory glossy panel; readability_dark boosted by OLED perfect blacks (min 4.6 nits). Thermals_noise 5.8: 54.6 dB Performance-mode fans, 105°C transient CPU spikes. Upgradability 7.0: SODIMM RAM + M.2 user-serviceable, no RAM info from Lenovo but verified dual-channel SODIMM per NBC teardown of WLAN/RAM access. ai_ml 6.0: CUDA + 8GB VRAM (limited for LLMs), NPU modest. repairability_service 6.5 tempered ~1pt per SHARED calibration (Legion-line warranty friction, BBY rating 3.67/5 vs pro 87%). Only 16" exists for this line — no 14" Legion 7i Gen 10. Image URL is BBY product CDN for this exact SKU.
